title: Former Mizzou forward Mitchell joins lawsuit against NCAA in Kentucky
text:
Former Mizzou basketball forward Mark Mitchell is joining a lawsuit against the NCAA in the state of Kentucky regarding the NCAA’s new eligibility rules.
Mitchell is one of 10 players a part of the lawsuit. The other nine are a mix of basketball, football and baseball players. According to Matt Jones of Kentucky Sports Radio, Mitchell has a hearing set for 10:30 a.m. Thursday in Louisville, Kentucky.
